name: @pipeworx/mcp-iso-ne

tools.name: isone_lmp
tools.description: ISO New England five-minute real-time locational marginal prices (LMP $/MWh) with their energy, congestion and loss components, for the eight New England load zones and hubs. ISO-NE runs the grid and wholesale market for CT, MA, ME, NH, RI and VT. Use for "New England power price right now", "Massachusetts wholesale electricity price", "ISO-NE zonal price spread". Requires an API key.

location_id.description: ISO-NE location id to fetch (e.g. 4000 = .H.INTERNAL_HUB, 4004 = .Z.MASSACHUSETTS). Omit for all locations.

date.description: Day to fetch as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the CURRENT five-minute interval; supply a date for that whole day.

_apiKey.description: ISO Express credential as "username:password" or its base64. Free account at https://www.iso-ne.com/participate/applications-status-changes/.

tools.name: isone_load
tools.description: ISO New England system load (total electricity demand) in MW at five-minute resolution for the six-state New England footprint. Use for "New England electricity demand right now", "ISO-NE peak load today", demand-response and capacity questions. Requires an API key.

date.description: Day to fetch as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the current interval.

_apiKey.description: ISO Express credential as "username:password" or its base64. Free account at https://www.iso-ne.com/participate/applications-status-changes/.

tools.name: isone_fuel_mix
tools.description: ISO New England generation by fuel category in MW — natural gas, nuclear, hydro, wind, solar, refuse, wood, coal, oil, landfill gas and net interchange with neighbouring grids — with the marginal-fuel flag ISO-NE publishes alongside it. Use for "what is New England burning right now", "ISO-NE renewable share", "how much gas is New England on". Requires an API key.

date.description: Day to fetch as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the current interval.

_apiKey.description: ISO Express credential as "username:password" or its base64. Free account at https://www.iso-ne.com/participate/applications-status-changes/.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-iso-ne forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the iso-ne pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
